author: The Career Blog
title: Hiring Digital Imaging Specialist / Digital Artist (remote project-based)
content:
🌍 HIRING: DIGITAL IMAGING SPECIALIST / DIGITAL ARTIST

📍 Location: Remote
💼 Employment Type: Project-based
⏳ Duration: 8–10 weeks
🕒 Work Hours: Up to 40 hours per week (part-time artists working 25–30 hours are welcome)
💵 Payment: USD

About the Role

A remote opportunity is available for a creative and detail-oriented Digital Artist with strong 2D and 3D design skills.

The role involves image annotation, editing, modification, and asset creation while maintaining visual consistency, quality, and attention to detail.

Required Software Skills

• Adobe Photoshop
• Adobe Illustrator

Key Responsibilities

• Edit, annotate, and modify images based on briefs and references.
• Create visual variations while maintaining consistency in style, colour, lighting, texture, and composition.
• Perform image retouching, compositing, cleanup, and background editing.
• Recreate and enhance textures, materials, objects, characters, and scenes.
• Follow detailed instructions and apply feedback accurately.
• Document workflows and required metadata.
• Deliver polished, production-ready visual assets.

Requirements

• Minimum of 2 years’ professional experience as a 2D/3D Artist or in a similar role.
• Strong portfolio showcasing stylised 2D/3D work and material exploration.
• Ability to recreate real-world materials and handcrafted textures.
• Good understanding of form, silhouette, and visual storytelling.
• Familiarity with non-photorealistic rendering (NPR).
• Knowledge of useful plugins/scripts for After Effects, 3ds Max, and Cinema 4D.
• Understanding of 3D modelling, topology, lighting, shading, and rendering.
• Good communication skills, attention to detail, and time management.

Additional Details

• Earnings depend on approved tasks and the current task mix.
• Candidates must be comfortable with 2D image annotation and editing tasks.
• Start date follows portfolio approval, a short assessment, and onboarding.
• Successful candidates may proceed to onboarding immediately after completing the assessment and portfolio review.
• Final selection depends on project requirements and assessment results.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should apply through the link below:

🔗 https://work.turing.com/r/731NhZy7O7
